text: A payday loan. A thousand free on their card.
Ever grabbed the expensive option because it was right there?
Researchers matched a payday lender with a big card company. Three thousand people had both.
A typical payday loan: about three hundred dollars, due next payday.
Price? Several hundred percent a year.
Now check their cards on the day they borrowed.
Two thirds had at least a thousand dollars of room.
Using the card would have saved a typical borrower almost two hundred dollars.
Their card room had been shrinking. Under pressure, we grab the nearest door.
So before you borrow fast, check what you have.
